tagline: Delivering life-changing treatments to patients faster.
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenues are the primary indicator of the company's performance, reflecting its ability to deliver biopharmaceutical development and medical device services to its clients.

kpis.name: Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenues generated from the sale of goods and services.
kpis.description: Revenues increased by 1.0% for the year ended December 31, 2025, driven by organic growth of 0.8% and a favorable currency impact of 0.2%.

kpis.name: Direct Costs
kpis.explanation: Costs directly attributable to the delivery of services.
kpis.description: Direct costs increased by 2.7% in 2025 compared to 2024, representing 81.5% of revenues versus 80.2% in the prior year.
kpis.signal: Direct cost growth outpacing revenue growth.

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: Expenses related to sales, administration, and general overhead.
kpis.description: SG&A expenses decreased by 18.6% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to cost reductions from transition service agreements and information technology initiatives.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in selling, general and administrative expenses.

kpis.name: Goodwill Impairment
kpis.explanation: Accounting charge resulting from the loss in value of an intangible asset.
kpis.description: A goodwill impairment charge of $797.9 million was recorded in 2025, specifically for the clinical development reporting unit.
kpis.signal: Significant one-time charge related to goodwill impairment.

kpis.name: Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Cost of interest paid on the company's debt.
kpis.description: Interest expense declined by 26.2% in 2025, primarily due to debt repayment of $70.2 million on term loan A and $412.5 million on term loan B completed in 2024.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in interest expense from debt repayment.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: The company employs approximately 14,300 employees across approximately 100 countries.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount in a restructuring environment.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 2.72 billion euros in the most recent year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 1.12 billion euros in the most recent year

kpis.name: Direct Costs as % of Revenues
kpis.explanation: Indicator of operational efficiency, showing the share of direct costs relative to revenues.
kpis.description: Direct costs increased in proportion to revenues, rising from 80.2% in 2024 to 81.5% in 2025, reflecting higher project costs and variable compensation expenses.

kpis.name: Restructuring and Other Charges
kpis.explanation: Costs incurred for business reorganization and workforce reduction.
kpis.description: Restructuring charges decreased by 12.0% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily related to operational optimization actions and elimination of redundant positions, including real estate asset impairments.

risks.title: High Debt Levels
risks.score_rationale: The company carries significant debt with an aggregate principal amount of $1,640.0 million incurred in connection with the Spin formation, which could weigh on its financial results. Additionally, the cost of debt is elevated, with an interest rate of 7.5% on senior secured notes.

risks.title: Customer Contract Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on its customer contracts, which can be terminated or modified at any time. This could adversely impact the company's revenues.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in many countries and is exposed to foreign exchange risks, which could impact its financial results. Currency fluctuations resulted in a foreign exchange loss of $26.9 million in 2025 compared to $10.6 million in 2024, primarily driven by US dollar fluctuations against sterling and the euro.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The clinical research services market is highly competitive, and the company faces increased competition from other service providers. This could impact the company's pricing and sales volumes.

ai_positioning.summary: FTRE does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on financial statements, operations, and business segments, with no reference to AI.
